title: Gratuity private-beta review decision
authorityBoundary: The deterministic rule executes before retrieval and provider output.
Complete and reported-gap inputs remain specialist-review.

Retrieval and provider output cannot classify an establishment, count employees, infer service, wages or workforce status, calculate gratuity, validate nomination or forfeiture, decide a claim or alter the deterministic result.
privacyBoundary: No names, contact details, addresses, registration numbers, employee identities, nominee or heir data, payroll, wages, payslips, attendance, service records, claims, disputes, notices, orders, medical or death information or evidence bodies.

Only controlled source-route, Chapter V, First Schedule, Rules, commencement, transition, classification-control, workforce-category-source, authority-process, escalation statuses and evidence references may be processed.
sourceBoundary: The pack reuses four exact controlled Social Security files already registered in the Source Register.
First Schedule and Chapter V materials are source-readiness inputs only and cannot create customer applicability or individual entitlement.
State and Union Territory instruments and customer-specific facts remain outside this bounded wave.

approval.notes: Software implementation and tests do not constitute legal, privacy, RAG, source-file, security or release approval.
